chunk 6 "Plugins and marketplaces — MCP servers bundled for distribution": line 93: "Plugins can ship more than MCP — a single plugin can deliver a tracker server plus the skills and agents that use it — but for tracker workflows the MCP-bundle dimension is the one this page covers" — abstraction-noun-stack sub-item ('the MCP-bundle dimension' stands in for the concrete claim, matching the compendium's own 'the bounded-window reality' example). All other sub-items checked clean across every chunk: no 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' construction, no anaphora/epistrophe triples, no number+own-retraction, no empty-leg verb triplets. 'Best path' (line 11), 'Cleanest UX of the three trackers' (line 77), and 'canonical case' (line 13) are comparative technical judgments between install paths/trackers, not training/exercise self-praise, so they don't trip the self-grading-superlative (value-prop-leak) sub-item.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Recast 'the MCP-bundle dimension is the one this page covers' as the concrete thing it names, e.g. 'this page only covers MCP bundling.'

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 3 "Jira — Atlassian Rovo MCP (official)": line 60: "**Once your org's first 3LO consent is complete and the domain is allowed, individual engineers don't need per-install admin approval**" — an ~18-word mid-paragraph clause bolded whole, not a ≲5-word handle (the deck's single worst instance). Pattern repeats across the deck: chunk 1 (lines 11-19) bolds all three numbered-list leads ('Claude.ai connector inheritance.' / '`claude mcp add` from the command line.' / 'First-party CLI via Bash.') plus the 'Vocabulary.' lead plus three inline glossary terms (Connector/Action/Tool) plus 'Sources:' — at least 7 bold spans on one slide; chunk 2 (lines 23-42) bolds three full paragraph-opening leads ('Default for AE101: `gh` CLI (Path 3).' / 'When to add the official GitHub MCP server instead.' / 'MCP install (Path 2):') plus 'Sources:'; chunk 4 (lines 68-81) bolds three full-sentence leads plus 'Sources:'; chunk 6 (lines 91-110) bolds eight spans including two inline terms (plugin/marketplace) and five full-sentence leads ('How MCPs ride inside plugins.' / 'Add a marketplace, then install a plugin:' / 'Official vs team marketplaces.' / 'Enterprise pre-registration.' / 'When to reach for plugin distribution over plain `claude mcp add`.'). Chunks 0, 5, and 7 stay within budget (1 bold span each — 'Last verified' / 'Sources:' / 'Sources:'). The doc's Last-verified date (2026-05-14) predates the 2026-07-09 emphasis-budget rule, so this reads as an unswept file rather than a deliberate choice.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Trim each flagged chunk to ≤1 bolded handle (or none); recast the bolded full-sentence leads as plain prose, keeping bold only for short coined-term handles (the Vocabulary glossary entries, 'plugin'/'marketplace').
